# Brand assets

`akoflow-logo.png` is the official AkôFlow logo for every platform and context. Use it for the site, navigation, footer, favicon, and any new AkôFlow branding. It contains the unchanged image previously named `akoflow-macos.png`; the old path remains available for existing links.

## Institutional logo sources

- `uffescience-logo.jpg`: https://uffescience.ic.uff.br/uffescience-logo.png — logo served by the UFF eScience Research Group website (JPEG bytes, retained without modification).
- `ic-uff-logo.png`: https://www.ic.uff.br/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/logo-ic.png — single-logo version linked from the Instituto de Computação's official visual identity page, https://www.ic.uff.br/identidade-visual/.

The footer preserves the original colors and proportions and links to the corresponding institutions.
